C five times on the player list opens campaign mode: stages
against rovers (they keep to the open ground) and ghosts (they
drift through bricks). Clear every enemy to go on. Three
campaigns come with the free set: first-steps, night-shift
and gauntlet.

THE GAME\nDrop bombs, get out of the way:
THE GAME
Drop bombs, get out of the way, and be the last one standing.
Bombs burst after two seconds in a cross of flame. Flames destroy
bricks, set off other bombs and knock out anyone they touch,
including whoever laid the bomb. Solid blocks stop them.
When the clock runs low the walls start closing in.
